feature: Announcements UI 4: the offer line at the foot of What's new while the reader has never chosen (Pick ▾ opens the kind boxes in place with Show these; the ✕ stamps user_prefs.feed_offer_closed_at), and the empty window's quiet line then offer line (handoff design_handoff_the99_announcements: Offer; small items 5: Offer-Empty, ERRATUM-offer-empty.md)
note: Run on a SCRATCH branch migrated through 0198, with HOME_FEED_ENABLED and ANNOUNCEMENTS_ENABLED on for the account (flag_overrides, scope user). Each row names its `phase`: the database state it needs, set before that phase and again before each width (one width per run), because Show these writes feed_kinds and the ✕ writes feed_offer_closed_at. The runner does not read `phase`; run the phases one at a time with a filtered copy of this file. Every phase starts from: every post baseline, feed_kinds {}, feed_kinds_declined {}, feed_offer_closed_at null. Phases: `rows` = two Wizards posts in the window (a Secret Lair and a Wizards news post, both seen, so no lead), never chosen; `rows-show` = the same, then a box ticked and Show these pressed; `rows-close` = the same, then the offer's ✕, then Home loaded again; `empty` = nothing in the window, never chosen; `empty-close` = the same, then the ✕, then Home loaded again; `all-off` = nothing in the window and every default-on kind declined (feed_kinds_declined = the three announcement kinds and spare-request), so no kind is on; `chosen` = the `rows` posts with one kind stamped in feed_kinds (new-set), so the reader has chosen. Widths are 390 and 1300 drawn tall (2000 and 1200) so What's new below the decks is in frame without fullPage.

rows.label: Home, never chosen, rows in the window: the offer line under the rows, on its rule (bold lead, rest, Pick ▾, ✕)
Home, never chosen, rows in the window, Pick pressed: the kind boxes open in place (one column on a phone, two from md), Show these and the in-app foot, the ✕ kept
Home, after a box ticked and Show these: the reader has chosen, the offer line is gone and the rows stay
Home, after the offer's ✕ and a fresh load: the line is gone for good, the rows kept
Home, never chosen, nothing in the window: the quiet line naming the kinds on, then the offer line under its rule
Home, nothing in the window, after the offer's ✕ and a fresh load: the quiet line alone
Home, every kind off, nothing in the window: the offer line alone in the box, no rule and no quiet line
Home, a reader who has chosen, rows in the window: no offer line
